# Rapid change of limiting nutrient in the Gulf of Bothnia, northern Baltic Sea

The following code was used to generate the figures in the following published paper:

Huseby S, Andersson A, Eriksson KIA, Brugel S, Ahlgren J (2026) Rapid change of limiting nutrient in the Gulf of Bothnia, northern Baltic Sea. *Sci Rep* **16**, 27798 (2026). <https://doi.org/10.1038/s41598-026-69219-6>

```{r read_libraries}

library(tidyverse)
library("readxl")
library(dplyr)
library(patchwork)
library(cowplot)
library(broom)

```

```{r, path}
#Set working path, to import data and to save images and updated dataframes
path <- "/Data"

```

# Calculations for the SYKE data set

## Calculate DIN

Ammonium is firstly summed with "nitrite nitrate" when that measurement exists. If it does not exist ammonium is instead summed with the separate measurements. If any of these measurements are missing, DIN is set to NA.

## Recalculate DIN och DIP to "M" from "µg/L"

DIN / 14.00672: Divides DIN in "µg/L" with the molar mass for nitrogen to get the unit "µM".

Phosphate.as.phosphorous / 30.973762: Divides DIP in "µg/L" with the molar mass for phosphorus to get the unit "µM".

```{r, finnish_data_calculations}

#read data
finska_data <- read.table(paste(path,"finska_data.txt",sep=""), sep="\t", quote='',header=T, fileEncoding = "UTF-8") %>%
  #Commas to dots
  mutate(across(everything(), ~ gsub(",", ".", .))) %>%
  #Calculate DIN
  mutate(across(c(Ammonium.as.nitrogen, Nitrite.nitrate.as.nitrogen, 
                  Nitrate.as.nitrogen, Nitrite.as.nitrogen), 
                ~ as.numeric(.))) %>%
  mutate(DIN = case_when(
      !is.na(Nitrite.nitrate.as.nitrogen) ~ Ammonium.as.nitrogen + Nitrite.nitrate.as.nitrogen,
      is.na(Nitrite.nitrate.as.nitrogen) & 
        !is.na(Nitrate.as.nitrogen) & !is.na(Nitrite.as.nitrogen) ~ 
        Ammonium.as.nitrogen + Nitrate.as.nitrogen + Nitrite.as.nitrogen,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_ )) %>%
  #Calculate to M
  mutate(across(c(DIN, Phosphate.as.phosphorous), ~ as.numeric(.))) %>%
  mutate(DIN_uM = DIN / 14.00672,
         DIP_uM = Phosphate.as.phosphorous / 30.973762 )

```

## Filter the SYKE data set

Filter out only the winter months december-march and sort these into the same winter season. Sort from year 1994-2022. Only use depths between 0-10m. Proceed with stations P1, P LAV4, Raahen ed RE15, Vav-11 V-4, Vav-10 V-3, Tallvarpen, Raum 385 and Raum 395.

```{r, finnish_data_filtered}
finnish_filtered <- finska_data %>%

  #Filter out years of interest
  filter(Year >= 1994 & Year <= 2022) %>%
  #Filter out months of interest
  filter(Month == "12" |
          Month == "01"|
          Month == "02"|

  #Sort december together with the following years winter season
  mutate(
    Winter_Season = case_when(
      Month %in% c("01", "02", "03") ~ paste0(Year),
      Month == "12" ~ paste0(Year + 1),
      TRUE ~ NA_character_  )) %>%
  #Filter out depths of interest (0-10m)
      # Extrahera det högsta värdet från varje värde eller intervall
   mutate( max_depth = if_else(

      as.numeric(str_extract(sampleDepthM, "\\d+\\.?\\d*$")), # Extrahera sista numret i intervallet

    )) %>%

  filter(max_depth <= 10) %>%
  #Filter out stations of interest

           site == "PERÃ„MERI LAV4" | #P LAV4

```

## Calculate averages for depths 0-10m

Filter out columns of interest and create a column for the category of "Limiting nutrient". Ad basin information for each station. Simplify the station names.

Also ad a column for limiting nutrient that divides into groups based on the DIN:DIP ratio:\
\* DIN.DIP \> 20 --\> P-lim\
\* 12 \< DIN.DIP \< 20 --\> Greyzone/Balanced\
\* 6 \< DIN.DIP \< 12 --\> N-lim\
\* 0 \< DIN.DIP \< 6 --\> very N-lim

```{r, depth_averages_finnish}
## Average DIN and DIP dor depths 0-10m
depth_averages_finnish <- finnish_filtered %>%  
  #Calculate averages for values that has the same station and group
  group_by(Date_Station, Date, site, Havsomr, Year, Month, Winter_Season, siteLatitudeWGS84, siteLongitudeWGS84) %>%
  summarise(
            Total.nitrogen = mean(as.numeric(`Total.nitrogen`), na.rm = TRUE),
            Total.phosphorous = mean(as.numeric(`Total.phosphorous`), na.rm = TRUE),
            DIN_uM = mean(as.numeric(`DIN_uM`), na.rm = TRUE),
            DIP_uM = mean(as.numeric(`DIP_uM`), na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(DIN.DIP = DIN_uM/DIP_uM) %>%
  mutate(TotalN.TotalP = Total.nitrogen/Total.phosphorous) %>%
  #Set levels of the limiting nutrient status based on DIN:DIP
  mutate(Limiting_nutrient = case_when(
    DIN.DIP > 20 ~ "P-lim",
    DIN.DIP >= 12 & DIN.DIP <= 20 ~ "Greyzone/Balanced",
    DIN.DIP < 12 & DIN.DIP > 6 ~ "N-lim",
    DIN.DIP <= 6 ~ "very_N-lim")) %>%
  mutate(Limiting_nutrient = factor(Limiting_nutrient, levels = c("very_N-lim", "N-lim", "Greyzone/Balanced", "P-lim"))) %>%
  #Create column Station to use instead of site. Match with map. Shorten name of Raum.
  mutate(Station = case_when(
          site %in% c("PERÃ„MERI 1") ~ "P1",
          site %in% c("PERÃ„MERI LAV4") ~ "P LAV4",
          site %in% c("Raahen ed RE15") ~ "Raahen ed RE15",
          site %in% c("Vav-11 V-4") ~ "Vav-11 V-4",
          site %in% c("Vav-10 V-3") ~ "Vav-10 V-3",
          site %in% c("Tallvarpen") ~ "Tallvarpen",
          site %in% c("Raum 385 JÃ¤rvil luot") ~ "Raum 385",
          site %in% c("Raum 395 Rounakari") ~ "Raum 395"  )) %>%
 # Add Type column (all are "Coast")
  mutate(Type = "Coast") %>%
#Ad Location: Finnish Coast
  mutate(Location = "Finnish Coast") %>%
  # Add Basin column based on site
  mutate(Basin = case_when(
    Station %in% c("P1", "P LAV4", "Raahen ed RE15") ~ "Bothnian Bay",
    TRUE ~ "Bothnian Sea"  # Default to Bothnian Sea for other stations
  ))
```

# Read and filter the SHARK data set

Handle Q-flags: https://www.smhi.se/oceanografi/oce_info_data/shark_web/downloads/SMHI_QC.pdf

If Q-flag == "\<" --\> Take half of reported value.

If Q-flag == "S" --\> Remove suspect value.

```{r, read_SMHI_data}

#read data and handle Q-flags
smhi <- read_excel(paste(path,"Svenska kustdata från SHARK.xlsx",sep="")) %>%
    select(`Vattenförekomst`, `År`, `Månad`, `Provtagningsdatum`, `Provtagningsdjup (m)`, `Provets latitud (DD)`, `Provets longitud (DD)`,
         `Total fosfor Tot-P (umol/l)`, `Q-flagga Total fosfor Tot-P`,
         `Total kväve Tot-N (umol/l)`, `Q-flagga Total kväve Tot-N`,
         `Fosfatfosfor PO4-P (umol/l)`, `Q-flagga Fosfatfosfor PO4-P`,
         `Nitritkväve NO2-N (umol/l)`, `Q-flagga Nitritkväve NO2-N`,
         `Nitratkväve NO3-N (umol/l)`, `Q-flagga Nitratkväve NO3-N`,
         `Nitrit+Nitratkväve NO2+NO3-N (umol/l)`, `Q-flagga Nitrit+Nitratkväve NO2+NO3-N`,
         `Ammoniumkväve NH4-N (umol/l)`, `Q-flagga Ammoniumkväve NH4-N`) %>%
  mutate(across(c(`Ammoniumkväve NH4-N (umol/l)`, 
                  `Nitrit+Nitratkväve NO2+NO3-N (umol/l)`, 
                 `Nitratkväve NO3-N (umol/l)`, 
                  `Nitritkväve NO2-N (umol/l)`), 
                ~ as.numeric(.))) %>%
  #Convert all Q-flag columns to type character
   mutate(across(starts_with("Q-flagga"), as.character)) %>%
  # Remove problematic Q-flag column
  # select(-`Q-flagga Syrgashalt O2 vattenhämtare`) %>%
  # Handle q-flagga för Total fosfor Tot-P
  mutate(`Total fosfor Tot-P (umol/l)` = case_when(
    `Q-flagga Total fosfor Tot-P` == "<" ~ as.numeric(`Total fosfor Tot-P (umol/l)`) / 2,
    `Q-flagga Total fosfor Tot-P` == "S" ~ NA_real_,
    TRUE ~ as.numeric(`Total fosfor Tot-P (umol/l)`)
  )) %>%
  # Handle q-flag for Total kväve Tot-N
  mutate(`Total kväve Tot-N (umol/l)` = case_when(
    `Q-flagga Total kväve Tot-N` == "<" ~ as.numeric(`Total kväve Tot-N (umol/l)`) / 2,
    `Q-flagga Total kväve Tot-N` == "S" ~ NA_real_,
    TRUE ~ as.numeric(`Total kväve Tot-N (umol/l)`)
  )) %>%
  # Handle q-flag for Fosfatfosfor PO4-P
  mutate(`Fosfatfosfor PO4-P (umol/l)` = case_when(
    `Q-flagga Fosfatfosfor PO4-P` == "<" ~ as.numeric(`Fosfatfosfor PO4-P (umol/l)`) / 2,
    `Q-flagga Fosfatfosfor PO4-P` == "S" ~ NA_real_,
    TRUE ~ as.numeric(`Fosfatfosfor PO4-P (umol/l)`)
  )) %>%
  # Handle q-flag for Nitritkväve NO2-N
  mutate(`Nitritkväve NO2-N (umol/l)` = case_when(
    `Q-flagga Nitritkväve NO2-N` == "<" ~ as.numeric(`Nitritkväve NO2-N (umol/l)`) / 2,
    `Q-flagga Nitritkväve NO2-N` == "S" ~ NA_real_,
    TRUE ~ as.numeric(`Nitritkväve NO2-N (umol/l)`)
  )) %>%
  # Handle q-flag for Nitratkväve NO3-N
  mutate(`Nitratkväve NO3-N (umol/l)` = case_when(
    `Q-flagga Nitratkväve NO3-N` == "<" ~ as.numeric(`Nitratkväve NO3-N (umol/l)`) / 2,
    `Q-flagga Nitratkväve NO3-N` == "S" ~ NA_real_,
    TRUE ~ as.numeric(`Nitratkväve NO3-N (umol/l)`)
  )) %>%
  # Handle q-flag for Nitrit+Nitratkväve NO2+NO3-N
  mutate(`Nitrit+Nitratkväve NO2+NO3-N (umol/l)` = case_when(
    `Q-flagga Nitrit+Nitratkväve NO2+NO3-N` == "<" ~ as.numeric(`Nitrit+Nitratkväve NO2+NO3-N (umol/l)`) / 2,
    `Q-flagga Nitrit+Nitratkväve NO2+NO3-N` == "S" ~ NA_real_,
    TRUE ~ as.numeric(`Nitrit+Nitratkväve NO2+NO3-N (umol/l)`)
  )) %>%
  # Handle q-flag for Ammoniumkväve NH4-N
  mutate(`Ammoniumkväve NH4-N (umol/l)` = case_when(
    `Q-flagga Ammoniumkväve NH4-N` == "<" ~ as.numeric(`Ammoniumkväve NH4-N (umol/l)`) / 2,
    `Q-flagga Ammoniumkväve NH4-N` == "S" ~ NA_real_,
    TRUE ~ as.numeric(`Ammoniumkväve NH4-N (umol/l)`)
  ))

```

## Filter SHARK data

Perform calculations and data filtration as for the SYKE data. Select stations Gårdsfjärden, "Söderhamnsfjärden, Ljusnefjärden och Östhammar.

```{r, filter_SMHI_data}

smhi_filtered <- smhi %>%
  #Select columns of interest
  select(`Vattenförekomst`, `År`, `Månad`, `Provtagningsdatum`, `Provtagningsdjup (m)`, `Provets latitud (DD)`, `Provets longitud (DD)`,
         `Total fosfor Tot-P (umol/l)`, `Q-flagga Total fosfor Tot-P`,
         `Total kväve Tot-N (umol/l)`, `Q-flagga Total kväve Tot-N`,
         `Fosfatfosfor PO4-P (umol/l)`, `Q-flagga Fosfatfosfor PO4-P`,
         `Nitritkväve NO2-N (umol/l)`, `Q-flagga Nitritkväve NO2-N`,
         `Nitratkväve NO3-N (umol/l)`, `Q-flagga Nitratkväve NO3-N`,
         `Nitrit+Nitratkväve NO2+NO3-N (umol/l)`, `Q-flagga Nitrit+Nitratkväve NO2+NO3-N`,
         `Ammoniumkväve NH4-N (umol/l)`, `Q-flagga Ammoniumkväve NH4-N`) %>%
  #Calculate DIN
  mutate(across(c(`Ammoniumkväve NH4-N (umol/l)`, 
                  `Nitrit+Nitratkväve NO2+NO3-N (umol/l)`, 
                 `Nitratkväve NO3-N (umol/l)`, 
                  `Nitritkväve NO2-N (umol/l)`), 
                ~ as.numeric(.))) %>%
  mutate(DIN = case_when(
      !is.na(`Nitrit+Nitratkväve NO2+NO3-N (umol/l)`) ~ `Ammoniumkväve NH4-N (umol/l)` + `Nitrit+Nitratkväve NO2+NO3-N (umol/l)`,
      is.na(`Nitrit+Nitratkväve NO2+NO3-N (umol/l)`) & 
        !is.na(`Nitratkväve NO3-N (umol/l)`) & !is.na(`Nitritkväve NO2-N (umol/l)`) ~ 
        `Ammoniumkväve NH4-N (umol/l)` + `Nitratkväve NO3-N (umol/l)` + `Nitritkväve NO2-N (umol/l)`,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_ )) %>%
  #No need to recalculate since 1 µM = 1 µmol/l. Rename columns to match with finnish data
  mutate(across(c(DIN, `Fosfatfosfor PO4-P (umol/l)`), ~ as.numeric(.))) %>%
  mutate(DIN_uM = DIN,
         DIP_uM = `Fosfatfosfor PO4-P (umol/l)`,
         Total.nitrogen = `Total kväve Tot-N (umol/l)`,
         Total.phosphorous = `Total fosfor Tot-P (umol/l)` ) %>%
  #Filter stations of interest
  filter( Vattenförekomst == "Gårdsfjärden" |
          Vattenförekomst == "Söderhamnsfjärden" |
          Vattenförekomst == "Ljusnefjärden" |
          Vattenförekomst == "Östhammars kustvatten") %>%
  mutate(Vattenförekomst = case_when(Vattenförekomst == "Östhammars kustvatten" ~ "Östhammar", TRUE ~ Vattenförekomst)) %>%
  #Create columns to match with the finnish data
  mutate(Year = as.numeric(År)) %>%
  mutate(Month = as.numeric(Månad)) %>%
  mutate(Date = Provtagningsdatum) %>%
  mutate(Date_Station = paste(Date, Vattenförekomst, sep = "_")) %>%
  #Filter out years of interest
  filter(Year >= 1994 & Year <= 2022) %>%
  #Filter out months of interest
  filter(Month == "12" |
          Month == "1"|
          Month == "2"|
          Month == "3") %>%
  #Sort december together with the following years winter season
  mutate(
    Winter_Season = case_when(
      Month %in% c("1", "2", "3") ~ paste0(Year),
      Month == "12" ~ paste0(Year + 1),
      TRUE ~ NA_character_  )) %>%
  #Filter sampling depths <= 10
  filter(as.numeric(`Provtagningsdjup (m)`) <= 10) %>%
  #Match with other datasets by creating a Station-column
  mutate(Station = Vattenförekomst)
```

## Depth averages SHARK

```{r, depth_averages_smhi}

depth_averages_smhi <- smhi_filtered %>%  
  select(`Vattenförekomst`, Year, Month, `Provtagningsdatum`, `Provtagningsdjup (m)`, Winter_Season, `Provets latitud (DD)`, `Provets longitud (DD)`, DIN_uM, DIP_uM, Date_Station, Total.nitrogen, Total.phosphorous,
         `Total fosfor Tot-P (umol/l)`, `Q-flagga Total fosfor Tot-P`,
         `Total kväve Tot-N (umol/l)`, `Q-flagga Total kväve Tot-N`,
         `Fosfatfosfor PO4-P (umol/l)`, `Q-flagga Fosfatfosfor PO4-P`,
         `Nitritkväve NO2-N (umol/l)`, `Q-flagga Nitritkväve NO2-N`,
         `Nitratkväve NO3-N (umol/l)`, `Q-flagga Nitratkväve NO3-N`,
         `Nitrit+Nitratkväve NO2+NO3-N (umol/l)`, `Q-flagga Nitrit+Nitratkväve NO2+NO3-N`,
         `Ammoniumkväve NH4-N (umol/l)`, `Q-flagga Ammoniumkväve NH4-N`) %>%
  #Calculate averages for values that has the same station and group
  group_by(Date_Station, Vattenförekomst, Year, Month, Winter_Season, `Provets latitud (DD)`, `Provets longitud (DD)`) %>%
  summarise(
            Total.nitrogen = mean(as.numeric(`Total.nitrogen`), na.rm = TRUE),
            Total.phosphorous = mean(as.numeric(`Total.phosphorous`), na.rm = TRUE),
            DIN_uM = mean(as.numeric(`DIN_uM`), na.rm = TRUE),
            DIP_uM = mean(as.numeric(`DIP_uM`), na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(DIN.DIP = DIN_uM/DIP_uM) %>%
  mutate(TotalN.TotalP = Total.nitrogen/Total.phosphorous) %>%
  #Set levels of the limiting nutrient status based on DIN:DIP
  mutate(Limiting_nutrient = case_when(
    DIN.DIP > 20 ~ "P-lim",
    DIN.DIP >= 12 & DIN.DIP <= 20 ~ "Greyzone/Balanced",
    DIN.DIP < 12 & DIN.DIP > 6 ~ "N-lim",
    DIN.DIP <= 6 ~ "very_N-lim")) %>%
  mutate(Limiting_nutrient = factor(Limiting_nutrient, levels = c("very_N-lim", "N-lim", "Greyzone/Balanced", "P-lim"))) %>%
  #Ad Type: Coast or Offshore
    mutate(Type = case_when(
    Vattenförekomst %in% c("Gårdsfjärden", "Söderhamnsfjärden", "Ljusnefjärden", "Östhammar") ~ "Coast", 
    TRUE ~ NA_character_  )) %>%
  #Ad Location: Swedish Coast
  mutate(Location = case_when(
    Vattenförekomst %in% c("Gårdsfjärden", "Söderhamnsfjärden", "Ljusnefjärden", "Östhammar") ~ "Swedish Coast", 
    TRUE ~ NA_character_  )) %>%
  # Add Basin
  mutate(Basin = case_when(
    Vattenförekomst %in% c("Gårdsfjärden", "Söderhamnsfjärden", "Ljusnefjärden", "Östhammar") ~ "Bothnian Sea",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_  )) %>%
  #Match with other datasets by creating a Station-column
  mutate(Station = Vattenförekomst)

```

# Read SR3 data

Read SR3 (C24) data from SYKE (Finnish monitoring). This is the same station as C24 in dBotnia (Swedish monitoring). Repeat all filtering and calculation steps as for the SYKE dataset. They could not be combined in the beginning since not all column names are the same.

```{r, read_sr3}

#read data
depth_averages_sr3 <- read_excel(paste(path,"Vattenkvalitet_uttagymparisto_250109_SR3-C24.xlsx",sep="")) %>%
  #Create missing columns so can use same calculations as before
  mutate(`Nitrate as nitrogen µg/l` = NA_real_ ) %>%
  #Convert to numeric values
    mutate(across(c(`Ammonium as nitrogen µg/l`, `Nitrite nitrate as nitrogen µg/l`, 
                  `Nitrate as nitrogen µg/l`, `Nitrite as nitrogen µg/l`), 
                ~ as.numeric(.))) %>%
  #Calculate DIN
  mutate(DIN = case_when(
  !is.na(`Nitrite nitrate as nitrogen µg/l`) ~ as.numeric(`Ammonium as nitrogen µg/l`) + as.numeric(`Nitrite nitrate as nitrogen µg/l`),
  is.na(`Nitrite nitrate as nitrogen µg/l`) & 
    !is.na(`Nitrate as nitrogen µg/l`) & !is.na(`Nitrite as nitrogen µg/l`) ~ 
    as.numeric(`Ammonium as nitrogen µg/l`) + as.numeric(`Nitrate as nitrogen µg/l`) + as.numeric(`Nitrite as nitrogen µg/l`),
  TRUE ~ NA_real_)) %>%
  #Recalculate to µM
    mutate(across(c(DIN, `Phosphate as phosphorous µg/l`), ~ as.numeric(.))) %>%
  mutate(DIN_uM = DIN / 14.00672,
         DIP_uM = `Phosphate as phosphorous µg/l` / 30.973762 ) %>%
  mutate(Year = as.numeric(substr(time, 1, 4))) %>%
  mutate(Month = substr(time, 6, 7)) %>%
  mutate(Date = substr(time, 1, 10)) %>%
  mutate(Date_Station = paste(Date, site, sep = "_")) %>%
  #Filter out years of interest
  filter(Year >= 1994 & Year <= 2022) %>%
  #Filter out months of interest
  filter(Month == "12" |
          Month == "01"|
          Month == "02"|
          Month == "03") %>%
  #Sort december together with the following years winter season
  mutate(
    Winter_Season = case_when(
      Month %in% c("01", "02", "03") ~ paste0(Year),
      Month == "12" ~ paste0(Year + 1),
      TRUE ~ NA_character_  )) %>%
  #Filter out depths of interest (0-10m)
      # Extrahera det högsta värdet från varje värde eller intervall
   mutate( max_depth = if_else(
      str_detect(sampleDepthM, "-"),                        # Om det är ett intervall
      as.numeric(str_extract(sampleDepthM, "\\d+\\.?\\d*$")), # Extrahera sista numret i intervallet
      as.numeric(sampleDepthM)                              # Om inte, konvertera direkt till numeriskt
    )) %>%
  # Filtrera baserat på max_depth
  filter(max_depth <= 10) %>%
    #Calculate averages for values that has the same station and group
  group_by(Date_Station, Date, site, Year, Month, Winter_Season, siteLatitudeWGS84, siteLongitudeWGS84) %>%
  summarise(
            Total.nitrogen = mean(as.numeric(`Total nitrogen µg/l`), na.rm = TRUE),
            Total.phosphorous = mean(as.numeric(`Total phosphorous µg/l`), na.rm = TRUE),
            DIN_uM = mean(as.numeric(`DIN_uM`), na.rm = TRUE),
            DIP_uM = mean(as.numeric(`DIP_uM`), na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(DIN.DIP = DIN_uM/DIP_uM) %>%
  mutate(TotalN.TotalP = Total.nitrogen/Total.phosphorous) %>%
  #Set levels of the limiting nutrient status based on DIN:DIP
  mutate(Limiting_nutrient = case_when(
    DIN.DIP > 20 ~ "P-lim",
    DIN.DIP >= 12 & DIN.DIP <= 20 ~ "Greyzone/Balanced",
    DIN.DIP < 12 & DIN.DIP > 6 ~ "N-lim",
    DIN.DIP <= 6 ~ "very_N-lim")) %>%
  mutate(Limiting_nutrient = factor(Limiting_nutrient, levels = c("very_N-lim", "N-lim", "Greyzone/Balanced", "P-lim"))) %>%
  #Create column Station to use instead of site. Match with map. Rename SR3 to C24/SR3.
  mutate(Station = case_when(
          site %in% c("SR3") ~ "C24/SR3")) %>%
 # Add Type column (all are "Offshore")
  mutate(Type = "Offshore") %>%
  # Add Basin column based on site
  mutate(Basin = "Bothnian Sea") %>%
#Ad Location: OFFshore
  mutate(Location = "Offshore")

```

# Read dBotnia data

Calculate winter season as before and match column names with the previous data sets. Take half of the measured value when the Q-value is on the detection limit, as for the SHARK data. Filter station "RA2","A5", "A13", "B3", "B7", "GA1", "C1", "C3", "C14", "C24/SR3". The name of station C24 is changes to C24/SR3 to later be combined with the SYKE data set.

```{r, read_dbotnia}

#Chemistry from dBotnia - Calculated data
depth_averages_dbotnia <- read.table(paste(path,"dBotnia - Kemidata - discrete depths.csv",sep=""), sep="\t", quote='',header=T, fileEncoding = "latin1" )   %>%
  #Use Date instead of Cruise to match with other datasets ID
  mutate(Date = substr(SampleDate, 1, 10)) %>%
  #Create unique ID for Cruise combined with Station. Match with finnish data --> Use the name "Date" instead of cruise
  mutate(Date_Station = paste(Date, Station, sep = "_")) %>%
  #Create column for Year from the Cruise column
  mutate(Year = substr(Cruise, 1, 4)) %>%
  mutate(Year = as.numeric(substr(Year, 1, 4))) %>%
  #Remove years before 1994 and after 2022 by 
  filter(Year >= 1994 & Year <= 2022) %>%
  #Select stations
  filter( Station == "A5" |
          Station == "A13" |
          Station == "B3" |
          Station == "B7" | 
          Station == "C1" |
          Station == "C3" |
          Station == "C14" |
          Station == "C24" |
          Station == "GA1" |
          Station == "RA2" ) %>%
  # Match with map. Rename C24 to C24/SR3. Keep other stations unchanged
mutate(Station = case_when(
  Station == "C24" ~ "C24/SR3", TRUE ~ Station)) %>%
  #Filter out depths of interest (0-10m)
  filter(Depth..decibar. =="0" |
          Depth..decibar. =="1" |
          Depth..decibar. =="2" |
          Depth..decibar. =="4" |
          Depth..decibar. =="6" |
          Depth..decibar. =="8" | 
         Depth..decibar. =="10") %>%
  #select measurements/information of interest
  select(Date_Station, Cruise, Station, DOC...M., Seccidepth..m., Temperature..ºC., Salinity..psu., pH, Total.N...M., Total.P...M., NO3...M., NO2...M., NH4...M., PO4.P...M., SiO4...M., Humus...g.l., ChlA...g.l., CO2fixation..µg.C.dm..3.d..1., BactAbund..cells.dm..3., BactGrowth..cells.dm..3.d..1., BactResp.µmol.O2.dm.3.d.1., Year, SampleDate, q_PO4.P, q_NO3, q_NO2, q_NH4, q_Total.N, q_Total.P) %>%
  #replace all commas for dots.
  mutate_at(vars(DOC...M., Seccidepth..m., Temperature..ºC., Salinity..psu., pH, Total.N...M., Total.P...M., NO3...M., NO2...M., NH4...M., PO4.P...M., SiO4...M., Humus...g.l., ChlA...g.l., CO2fixation..µg.C.dm..3.d..1., BactAbund..cells.dm..3., BactGrowth..cells.dm..3.d..1., BactResp.µmol.O2.dm.3.d.1.), 
             list(~ gsub(",", ".", .))) %>%
  #Calculate a column for nutrients depending on the quality score, set half the value of the detection limit
  mutate(PO4P = ifelse(q_PO4.P == 7, 0.5*as.numeric(PO4.P...M.) , PO4.P...M.),
         NO3 = ifelse(q_NO3 == 7, 0.5*as.numeric(NO3...M.) , NO3...M.),
         NO2 = ifelse(q_NO2 == 7, 0.5*as.numeric(NO2...M.) , NO2...M.),
         NH4 = ifelse(q_NH4 == 7, 0.5*as.numeric(NH4...M.) , NH4...M.),
         TotN = ifelse(q_Total.N == 7, 0.5*as.numeric(Total.N...M.), Total.N...M.),
         TotP = ifelse(q_Total.P == 7, 0.5*as.numeric(Total.P...M.), Total.P...M.) ) %>%
  #Calculate a column for DIN and DIP
  mutate(DIN = ( as.numeric(`NO3`) + as.numeric(`NO2`) + as.numeric(`NH4`) )) %>%
  mutate(DIP = ( as.numeric(`PO4P`) )) %>%
  #Calculate a column for the N:P ratio (DIN:DIP)
  mutate(DIN.DIP = ( as.numeric(`NO3`) + as.numeric(`NO2`) + as.numeric(`NH4`) ) / as.numeric(`PO4P`) ) %>%
  #Calculate a column for Total N and Total P ratio
  mutate(TotalN.TotalP = as.numeric(`TotN`)/as.numeric(`TotP`)) %>%
  #Calculate averages for values that has the same station and group
  group_by(Cruise, Station, Date_Station) %>%
  summarise(
            DOC = mean(as.numeric(`DOC...M.`), na.rm = TRUE),
            Seccidepth = mean(as.numeric(`Seccidepth..m.`), na.rm = TRUE),
            Temp = mean(as.numeric(`Temperature..ºC.`), na.rm = TRUE),
            Salinity = mean(as.numeric(`Salinity..psu.`), na.rm = TRUE),
            Total.nitrogen = mean(as.numeric(`TotN`), na.rm = TRUE),
            Total.phosphorous = mean(as.numeric(`TotP`), na.rm = TRUE),
            NO3 = mean(as.numeric(`NO3`), na.rm = TRUE),
            NO2 = mean(as.numeric(`NO2`), na.rm = TRUE),
            NH4 = mean(as.numeric(`NH4`), na.rm = TRUE),
            PO4P = mean(as.numeric(`PO4P`), na.rm = TRUE),
            SiO4 = mean(as.numeric(`SiO4...M.`), na.rm = TRUE),
            Humus = mean(as.numeric(`Humus...g.l.`), na.rm = TRUE),
            ChlA = mean(as.numeric(`ChlA...g.l.`), na.rm = TRUE),
            CO2fix = mean(as.numeric(`CO2fixation..µg.C.dm..3.d..1.`), na.rm = TRUE),
            BactAbund = mean(as.numeric(`BactAbund..cells.dm..3.`), na.rm = TRUE),
            BactGrowth = mean(as.numeric(`BactGrowth..cells.dm..3.d..1.`), na.rm = TRUE),
            BactResp = mean(as.numeric(`BactResp.µmol.O2.dm.3.d.1.`), na.rm = TRUE),
            DIN_uM = mean(as.numeric(`DIN`), na.rm = TRUE),
            DIP_uM = mean(as.numeric(`DIP`), na.rm = TRUE),
            DIN.DIP = mean(as.numeric(`DIN.DIP`), na.rm = TRUE),
            TotalN.TotalP = mean(as.numeric(`TotalN.TotalP`), na.rm = TRUE),
            Year = mean(as.numeric(`Year`), na.rm = TRUE),
            Month = str_split(first(SampleDate), "-") %>% sapply(`[[`, 2),
            ) %>%
  #Set levels of the limiting nutrient status based on DIN:DIP
  mutate(Limiting_nutrient = case_when(
    DIN.DIP > 20 ~ "P-lim",
    DIN.DIP >= 12 & DIN.DIP <= 20 ~ "Greyzone/Balanced",
    DIN.DIP < 12 & DIN.DIP > 6 ~ "N-lim",
    DIN.DIP <= 6 ~ "very_N-lim")) %>%
  mutate(Limiting_nutrient = factor(Limiting_nutrient, levels = c("very_N-lim", "N-lim", "Greyzone/Balanced", "P-lim"))) %>%
    #Ad column for Basin 
  mutate(Basin = case_when(
    Station %in% c("RA2","A5", "A13") ~ "Bothnian Bay",
    Station %in% c("B3", "B7", "GA1", "C1", "C3", "C14", "C24/SR3") ~ "Bothnian Sea" )) %>%
  #Sort out winter months
  filter( Month == "01" | 
          Month == "02" | 
          Month =="03" | 
          Month =="12") %>%
  #Sort december together with the following years winter season
  mutate(Winter_Season = case_when(
      Month %in% c("01", "02", "03") ~ paste0(Year),
      Month == "12" ~ paste0(Year + 1),
      TRUE ~ NA_character_  )) %>%
  #Ad Basin
 mutate(Basin = case_when(
    Station %in% c("A5", "A13") ~ "Bothnian Bay",
    Station %in% c("C1", "C3", "C14", "C24/SR3") ~ "Bothnian Sea",
    Station %in% c("B3", "B7") ~ "Bothnian Sea",
    Station %in% c("GA1") ~ "Bothnian Sea",
    Station %in% c("RA2") ~ "Bothnian Bay")) %>%
  #Ad Type
  mutate(Type = case_when(
    Station %in% c("A5", "A13", "C1", "C3", "C14", "C24/SR3") ~ "Offshore", 
    TRUE ~ "Coast"  )) %>%
  #Ad Location: Swedish Coast
  mutate(Location = case_when(
    Station %in% c("A5", "A13", "C1", "C3", "C14", "C24/SR3") ~ "Offshore", 
    TRUE ~ "Swedish Coast"  ))

```

# Merge datasets

```{r, merge_datasets}

# Select only the required columns before the join
depth_averages_combined <- depth_averages_dbotnia %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(Station, Type, Location, Date_Station, Basin, DIN_uM, DIP_uM, Total.nitrogen, Total.phosphorous, DIN.DIP, Winter_Season, Limiting_nutrient) %>%
  full_join(
    depth_averages_sr3 %>% 
      select(Station, Type, Location, Date_Station, Basin, DIN_uM, DIP_uM, Total.nitrogen, Total.phosphorous, DIN.DIP, Winter_Season, Limiting_nutrient), 
    by = c("Station", "Type", "Location", "Date_Station", "Basin", "DIN_uM", "DIP_uM", "Total.nitrogen", "Total.phosphorous", "DIN.DIP", "Winter_Season", "Limiting_nutrient") ) %>%
  full_join(
    depth_averages_finnish %>%
      select(Station, Type, Location, Date_Station, Basin, DIN_uM, DIP_uM, Total.nitrogen, Total.phosphorous, DIN.DIP, Winter_Season, Limiting_nutrient), 
    by = c("Station", "Type", "Location", "Date_Station", "Basin", "DIN_uM", "DIP_uM", "Total.nitrogen", "Total.phosphorous", "DIN.DIP", "Winter_Season", "Limiting_nutrient") ) %>%
  full_join(
    depth_averages_smhi %>%
      select(Station, Type, Location, Date_Station, Basin, DIN_uM, DIP_uM, Total.nitrogen, Total.phosphorous, DIN.DIP, Winter_Season, Limiting_nutrient), 
    by = c("Station", "Type", "Location", "Date_Station", "Basin", "DIN_uM", "DIP_uM", "Total.nitrogen", "Total.phosphorous", "DIN.DIP", "Winter_Season", "Limiting_nutrient") )

```

# Figures - DIN:DIP

## Linear Regression - Per Station

This figure below has the final station order used in the reviewed manuscript, arranged from north to south.

Line fitting comparison:

Instead of a barplot with many smaller figures, arrange the stations in a scatterplot divided into 6 panels depending on Basin (Bothnian Bay or Bothnian Sea) and Location (Coast or Offshore). For visualizing spatiotemporal trends, we compared different line fittings to find the most suitable option.

3 alternatives were evaluated:\
\* Linear regression,\
\* Moving average with loess smoothing\
\* GAM spline-smoothing

Linear regression was the best fit, the other alternatives is no longer shown in the code.

```{r, fitting_average_fig1, fig.width=10, fig.height=10}
#| label: fig-linefitting_linear
#| fig-cap: The figure explores the most suitable option for displaying spatiotemporal trends in DIN:DIP. Overall, the linear trend seem to capture this decently.

  mutate(Station = factor(Station, levels = c("RA2",

                                               "B7",

                                               "GA1", 
                                               "C3",
                                               "C1",

                                               "C14",

                                               "Söderhamnsfjärden",

                                               "C24/SR3",

                                               "Raum 395",
                                               "Östhammar"))) %>%
  mutate(Location = factor(Location, levels = c("Swedish Coast", "Finnish Coast", "Offshore"))) %>%
```

Linear regression - Per station

The figure below is arranged according to the previous station order that is divided according to basin and location.

```{r, linear_fig, fig.width=10, fig.height=10}
#| label: fig-linear_station
#| fig-cap: DIN:DIP per station and linear regression with corresponding equation. Average and standard deviation calculated for each station. The red dashed line indicate the Redfield Ratio, where DIN:DIP is 16.

# Beräkna medelvärde och standardavvikelse för varje station och Winter_Season
plot_data_with_sd <- depth_averages_combined %>%
  filter(!is.na(DIN.DIP)) %>%
  group_by(Location, Basin, Station, Winter_Season) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_value = mean(DIN.DIP, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_value = sd(DIN.DIP, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Location = factor(Location, levels = c("Swedish Coast", "Finnish Coast", "Offshore")),
    Basin = factor(Basin, levels = c("Bothnian Bay", "Bothnian Sea"))
  )

# Anpassa linjära modeller per facet
lm_results <- depth_averages_combined %>%
  mutate(Location = factor(Location, levels = c("Swedish Coast", "Finnish Coast", "Offshore")),
         Basin = factor(Basin, levels = c("Bothnian Bay", "Bothnian Sea")),
         Winter_Season = as.numeric(Winter_Season)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(DIN.DIP) & DIN.DIP > 0) %>%  # Ta bort NaN och noll/negativa värden för log-transformering
  group_by(Location, Basin) %>%
  do({
    model <- lm(DIN.DIP ~ Winter_Season, data = .)  # Anpassa linjär regression
    tidy(model) %>%  # Extrahera modellresultat
      mutate(formula_text = paste0("y = ", signif(coef(model)[1], 3), " ", signif(coef(model)[2], 3), "x")) %>%
      filter(term == "Winter_Season")  # Filtrera ut rad för p-värdet
  }) %>%
  select(Location, Basin, formula_text, p_value = p.value)

# Skapa plott med standardavvikelse och linjär regression
combined_plot_linear_per_station <- plot_data_with_sd %>%
    mutate(Winter_Season = as.numeric(Winter_Season)) %>%
    mutate(Station = factor(Station, levels = c("RA2", 
                                              
                                               "P1", 
                                               "P LAV4", 
                                               "Raahen ed RE15",
                                              
                                               "A5",
                                               "A13",
                                              
                                               "B3", 
                                               "B7", 
                                               "GA1", 
                                               "Gårdsfjärden", 
                                               "Söderhamnsfjärden", 
                                               "Ljusnefjärden", 
                                               "Östhammar", 
                                              
                                              "Vav-11 V-4", 
                                               "Vav-10 V-3",
                                               "Tallvarpen", 
                                               "Raum 385", 
                                               "Raum 395",
                                              
                                               "C1",
                                               "C3",
                                               "C14",
                                               "C24/SR3"))) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Winter_Season, y = mean_value)) +
  geom_point(aes(color = Station), size = 2, alpha = 0.6) +  # Punkter med färger för stationer
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean_value - sd_value, ymax = mean_value + sd_value, color = Station),
                width = 0.2, alpha = 0.6) +  # Felstaplar för SD
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = "black", size = 0.25) +  # Linjär regression
  geom_text(data = lm_results, aes(x = Inf, y = Inf, label = paste0(formula_text, "\np = ", signif(p_value, 3))),
            hjust = 1.1, vjust = 1.2, inherit.aes = FALSE, size = 3) +  # Formel och p-värde
  geom_hline(aes(yintercept = 16, linetype = "Redfield Ratio"), color = "red") +  # Add horizontal line at y = 16
  scale_linetype_manual(
    name = "DIN:DIP = 16",  # Namn på legendkategorin
    values = c("Redfield Ratio" = "dashed")  # Dashad line for Redfield Ratio
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ Basin + Location, scales = "free", ncol = 3) +  # Facettera efter plats och bassäng
 # scale_y_log10() +
  labs(
    title = "DIN:DIP - Seasonal winter averages (0-10m depth) - per station \n",
    x = "\nWinter Season (December-March)",
    y = "DIN:DIP",
    color = "Station"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    strip.text = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold")
  )
```

## Linear Regression - Per Location

Final plot for the reviewed manuscript.

```{r, linear_fig_sum, fig.width=10, fig.height=10}
#| label: fig-linear_location
#| fig-cap: DIN:DIP with Linear Regression - Average and standard error calculated for each combination of Basin and Location. 

# Steg 1: Beräkna standardavvikelse och linjära modeller
summary_data <- depth_averages_combined %>%
  mutate(Location = factor(Location, levels = c("Swedish Coast", "Finnish Coast", "Offshore")),
         Basin = factor(Basin, levels = c("Bothnian Bay", "Bothnian Sea")),
         Winter_Season = as.numeric(Winter_Season)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(DIN.DIP) & DIN.DIP > 0) %>%  # Ta bort NaN och noll/negativa värden för log-transformering
  group_by(Location, Basin, Winter_Season) %>%
  reframe(  # Byt till reframe för att hantera flera stationer korrekt
    mean_value = mean(DIN.DIP, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_value = sd(DIN.DIP, na.rm = TRUE),
    se_value = sd(DIN.DIP, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()), #Standard error instead of standard deviation
    Station = unique(Station)  # Bevara stationer för färger
  )

# Steg 2: Anpassa linjära modeller per facet
lm_results <- depth_averages_combined %>%
  mutate(Location = factor(Location, levels = c("Swedish Coast", "Finnish Coast", "Offshore")),
         Basin = factor(Basin, levels = c("Bothnian Bay", "Bothnian Sea")),
         Winter_Season = as.numeric(Winter_Season)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(DIN.DIP) & DIN.DIP > 0) %>%  # Ta bort NaN och noll/negativa värden för log-transformering
  group_by(Location, Basin) %>%
  do({
    model <- lm(DIN.DIP ~ Winter_Season, data = .)  # Anpassa linjär regression
    tidy(model) %>%  # Extrahera modellresultat
      mutate(formula_text = paste0("y = ", signif(coef(model)[1], 3), " ", signif(coef(model)[2], 3), "x")) %>%
      filter(term == "Winter_Season")  # Filtrera ut rad för p-värdet
  }) %>%
  select(Location, Basin, formula_text, p_value = p.value)

# Lägg till linetype baserat på p-värde
lm_results <- lm_results %>%
  mutate(    p_value_num = round(as.numeric(p_value), 100),   #gör numerisk, antal värdesiffror
linetype_group = ifelse(p_value_num < 0.05, "p < 0.05", "p > 0.05"))

# Steg 3: Kombinera data med modellresultat
plot_data <- left_join(summary_data, lm_results, by = c("Location", "Basin"))

# Steg 4: Skapa plotten med linjär regression och standardavvikelse
combined_plot_location <- plot_data %>%
  mutate(Basin_Location = paste(Basin, Location, sep = ", ")) %>%
  mutate(Basin_Location = factor(Basin_Location, levels = c("Bothnian Bay, Swedish Coast", 
                                                            "Bothnian Sea, Swedish Coast", 
                                                            "Bothnian Bay, Finnish Coast", 
                                                            "Bothnian Sea, Finnish Coast", 
                                                            "Bothnian Bay, Offshore", 
                                                            "Bothnian Sea, Offshore"))) %>%
  mutate(ylim_max = ifelse(Basin_Location == "Bothnian Bay, Offshore", 1000, 400)) %>%  # Y-lim för varje panel
  ggplot(aes(x = Winter_Season, y = mean_value)) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean_value - se_value, ymax = mean_value + se_value, color = Basin_Location), width = 0.5, alpha = 0.6) +  # Felstaplar för SD
  geom_point(aes(color = Basin_Location), size = 2, alpha = 0.6) +  # Punkter med färg per station
  #geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = "black", size = 0.25) +  # Linjär regression
geom_smooth(data = plot_data,
            aes(linetype = linetype_group),
            method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = "black", size = 0.25) +
  #facet_wrap(~ Basin + Location, scales = "free", ncol = 3) +  # Facettera efter plats och bassäng
  facet_grid(Basin ~ Location, scales = "free") + 
  #scale_y_log10() +  # Log-transformera y-axeln
  geom_text(data = lm_results, aes(x = Inf, y = Inf, label = paste0(formula_text)),# "\np = ", signif(p_value, 3))),
            hjust = 1.1, vjust = 1.2, inherit.aes = FALSE, size = 3) +  # Formel och p-värde
  geom_hline(aes(yintercept = 16, linetype = "Redfield Ratio (DIN:DIP = 16)"), color = "red") +  # Add horizontal line at y = 16
  scale_linetype_manual(
  name = "Line types",
  values = c(
    #"p > 0.05" = "dashed",
    "p < 0.05" = "solid",
    "Redfield Ratio (DIN:DIP = 16)" = "dashed"
  )) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(
  "Bothnian Bay, Swedish Coast" = "#E41A1C",  # Orangeröd
  "Bothnian Bay, Finnish Coast" = "#FF7F00",  # Gulorange
  "Bothnian Bay, Offshore"      = "#4DAF4A",  # Grön
  "Bothnian Sea, Swedish Coast" = "#377EB8",  # Blå
  "Bothnian Sea, Finnish Coast" = "#984EA3",  # Lila
  "Bothnian Sea, Offshore"      = "#F781BF"   # Rosa
  )) +
  labs(
    title = "", #"DIN:DIP - Seasonal winter averages (0-10m depth) - per Location \n",
    x = "", # "\nWinter Season (December-March)",
    y = "DIN:DIP",
    color = "Basin and Location",
    linetype = "Line types"
  ) +
  guides(
  color = guide_legend(order = 1),
  linetype = guide_legend(order = 2)
) +
  theme_minimal() +
    theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.box = "vertical",  # staplar legender vertikalt
    strip.text = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold")
  )  ; combined_plot_location
```

```{r, din_station, fig.width=10, fig.height=10}
#| label: fig-din_station
#| fig-cap: DIN per Station

# Beräkna medelvärde och standardavvikelse för varje station och Winter_Season
plot_data_with_sd <- depth_averages_combined %>%
  filter(!is.na(DIN_uM)) %>%
  group_by(Location, Basin, Station, Winter_Season) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_value = mean(DIN_uM, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_value = sd(DIN_uM, na.rm = TRUE),
    se_value = sd(DIN_uM, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()), #Standard error instead of standard deviation
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Location = factor(Location, levels = c("Swedish Coast", "Finnish Coast", "Offshore")),
    Basin = factor(Basin, levels = c("Bothnian Bay", "Bothnian Sea"))
  )

# Anpassa linjära modeller per facet
lm_results <- depth_averages_combined %>%
  mutate(Location = factor(Location, levels = c("Swedish Coast", "Finnish Coast", "Offshore")),
         Basin = factor(Basin, levels = c("Bothnian Bay", "Bothnian Sea")),
         Winter_Season = as.numeric(Winter_Season)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(DIN_uM) & DIN_uM > 0) %>%  # Ta bort NaN och noll/negativa värden för log-transformering
  group_by(Location, Basin) %>%
  do({
    model <- lm(DIN_uM ~ Winter_Season, data = .)  # Anpassa linjär regression
    tidy(model) %>%  # Extrahera modellresultat
      mutate(formula_text = paste0("y = ", signif(coef(model)[1], 3), " + ", signif(coef(model)[2], 3), "x") )     %>%
      filter(term == "Winter_Season")  # Filtrera ut rad för p-värdet
  }) %>%
  select(Location, Basin, formula_text, p_value = p.value) %>%
  #Ad information about Stations to use in each facet 
  mutate(
    Station_text = case_when(
      Basin == "Bothnian Bay" & Location == "Swedish Coast" ~
        "Stations: RA2\n",
      Basin == "Bothnian Bay" & Location == "Finnish Coast" ~
        "Stations: P1 · P LAV4 · Raahen ed RE15\n",
      Basin == "Bothnian Bay" & Location == "Offshore" ~
        "Stations: A5 · A13\n",
      Basin == "Bothnian Sea" & Location == "Swedish Coast" ~
        "Stations: B3 · B7 · GA1 · Gårdsfjärden · \n Söderhamnsfjärden · Ljusnefjärden · Östhammar\n",
      Basin == "Bothnian Sea" & Location == "Finnish Coast" ~
        "Stations: Vav-11 V-4 · Vav-10 V-3 ·\n Tallvarpen · Raum 385 · Raum 395\n",
      Basin == "Bothnian Sea" & Location == "Offshore" ~
        "Stations: C3 · C1 · C14 · C24/SR3\n",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  )

# Lägg till linetype baserat på p-värde
lm_results <- lm_results %>%
  mutate(    p_value_num = round(as.numeric(p_value), 100),   #gör numerisk, antal värdesiffror
linetype_group = ifelse(p_value_num < 0.05, "p < 0.05", "p > 0.05")) %>%
 #Change p-value where not coherent with Mann-Kendall test
    mutate(
    linetype_group = ifelse(
      Location == "Finnish Coast" &
      Basin == "Bothnian Bay",
      "p > 0.05", linetype_group ))

combined_plot_din_station <- plot_data_with_sd %>%
    mutate(Winter_Season = as.numeric(Winter_Season)) %>%
  left_join(lm_results %>% select(Location, Basin, linetype_group),
            by = c("Location", "Basin")) %>%
    mutate(Station = factor(Station, levels = c("RA2", 
                                               "P1", 
                                               "P LAV4", 
                                               "A5",
                                               "A13",
                                               "Raahen ed RE15",
                                               "B3", 
                                               "B7", 
                                               "Vav-11 V-4", 
                                               "Vav-10 V-3",
                                               "GA1", 
                                               "C3",
                                               "C1",
                                               "Tallvarpen", 
                                               "C14",
                                               "Gårdsfjärden", 
                                               "Söderhamnsfjärden", 
                                               "Ljusnefjärden", 
                                               "C24/SR3",
                                               "Raum 385", 
                                               "Raum 395",
                                               "Östhammar"))) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Winter_Season, y = mean_value)) +
  geom_point(aes(color = Station), size = 2, alpha = 0.6) +  # Punkter med färger för stationer
 scale_color_manual(values = colors) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean_value - se_value, ymax = mean_value + se_value, color = Station),
                width = 0.2, alpha = 0.6) +  # Felstaplar för SD
  # CI for all panels
geom_smooth(
    method = "lm",
    se = TRUE,
    color = NA,
    fill = "grey70") +
  #Only plot solid lines when p<0.05 for linear regression AND Mann-Kendall
geom_smooth(
  data = ~ dplyr::filter(.x, linetype_group == "p < 0.05"),
  method = "lm",
  se = TRUE,
  color = "black",

  labs(
    title = "",
    x = "",
    y = "DIN (µM)",
    color = "Station",
    linetype = "Line types"
  ) +

  color = guide_legend(order = 1),

) +
```

```{r, din_location, fig.width=10, fig.height=7}
#| label: fig-din_location

# Steg 1: Beräkna standardavvikelse och linjära modeller för DIN
summary_data <- depth_averages_combined %>%
  mutate(Location = factor(Location, levels = c("Swedish Coast", "Finnish Coast", "Offshore")),
         Basin = factor(Basin, levels = c("Bothnian Bay", "Bothnian Sea")),
         Winter_Season = as.numeric(Winter_Season)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(DIN_uM) & DIN_uM > 0) %>%  # Ta bort NaN och noll/negativa värden
  group_by(Location, Basin, Winter_Season) %>%
  reframe(  # Byt till reframe för att hantera flera stationer korrekt
    mean_value = mean(DIN_uM, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_value = sd(DIN_uM, na.rm = TRUE),
    se_value = sd(DIN_uM, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()), #Standard error instead of standard deviation
    Station = unique(Station)  # Bevara stationer för färger
  )

# Steg 2: Anpassa linjära modeller per facet för DIN
lm_results <- depth_averages_combined %>%
  mutate(Location = factor(Location, levels = c("Swedish Coast", "Finnish Coast", "Offshore")),
         Basin = factor(Basin, levels = c("Bothnian Bay", "Bothnian Sea")),
         Winter_Season = as.numeric(Winter_Season)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(DIN_uM) & DIN_uM > 0) %>%  # Ta bort NaN och noll/negativa värden
  group_by(Location, Basin) %>%
  do({
    model <- lm(DIN_uM ~ Winter_Season, data = .)  # Anpassa linjär regression
    tidy(model) %>%  # Extrahera modellresultat
      mutate(formula_text = paste0("y = ", signif(coef(model)[1], 3), " + ", signif(coef(model)[2], 3), "x")) %>%
      filter(term == "Winter_Season")  # Filtrera ut rad för p-värdet
  }) %>%
  select(Location, Basin, formula_text, p_value = p.value)

# Lägg till linetype baserat på p-värde
lm_results <- lm_results %>%
  mutate(    p_value_num = round(as.numeric(p_value), 10),   #gör numerisk, tio värdesiffror
linetype_group = ifelse(p_value_num < 0.05, "p < 0.05", "p > 0.05"))

# Steg 3: Kombinera data med modellresultat
plot_data <- left_join(summary_data, lm_results, by = c("Location", "Basin"))

# Steg 4: Skapa plotten med linjär regression och standardavvikelse för DIN
combined_plot_din_location <- plot_data %>%
  mutate(Basin_Location = paste(Basin, Location, sep = ", ")) %>%
  mutate(Basin_Location = factor(Basin_Location, levels = c("Bothnian Bay, Swedish Coast", 
                                                            "Bothnian Sea, Swedish Coast", 
                                                            "Bothnian Bay, Finnish Coast", 
                                                            "Bothnian Sea, Finnish Coast", 
                                                            "Bothnian Bay, Offshore", 
                                                            "Bothnian Sea, Offshore"))) %>%
  mutate(ylim_max = ifelse(Basin_Location == "Bothnian Bay, Offshore", 1000, 400)) %>%  # Y-lim för varje panel
  ggplot(aes(x = Winter_Season, y = mean_value)) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean_value - se_value, ymax = mean_value + se_value, color = Basin_Location), width = 0.5, alpha = 0.6) +  # Felstaplar för SD
  geom_point(aes(color = Basin_Location), size = 2, alpha = 0.6) +  # Punkter med färg per station
  geom_smooth(aes(linetype = linetype_group),
            method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = "black", size = 0.25) +
  #facet_wrap(~ Basin + Location, scales = "free", ncol = 3) +  # Facettera efter plats och bassäng
  facet_grid(Basin ~ Location, scales = "free") +
  #scale_y_log10() +  # Log-transformera y-axeln
  geom_text(data = lm_results, aes(x = Inf, y = Inf, 
                                   label = paste0(formula_text)), 
                                   #"\np = ", signif(p_value, 3))),
                                   hjust = 1.1, vjust = 1.2, 
                                   inherit.aes = FALSE, size = 3) +  # Formel och p-värde
  scale_linetype_manual(
  name = "Line types",
  values = c(
    #"p > 0.05" = "dashed",
    "p < 0.05" = "solid"
  )) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(
  "Bothnian Bay, Swedish Coast" = "#E41A1C",  # Orangeröd
  "Bothnian Bay, Finnish Coast" = "#FF7F00",  # Gulorange
  "Bothnian Bay, Offshore"      = "#4DAF4A",  # Grön
  "Bothnian Sea, Swedish Coast" = "#377EB8",  # Blå
  "Bothnian Sea, Finnish Coast" = "#984EA3",  # Lila
  "Bothnian Sea, Offshore"      = "#F781BF"   # Rosa
  )) +
  labs(
    title = "",
    x = "",
    y = "DIN (µM)",
    color = "Basin and Location",
    linetype = "Line types"
  ) +
  guides(
  color = guide_legend(order = 1),
  linetype = guide_legend(order = 2)
) +
  theme_minimal() +
    theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.box = "vertical",  # staplar legender vertikalt
    strip.text = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold")
  )
```

```{r, patchwork_DIN_DIP_station, fig.width=10, fig.height=14}
  ( combined_plot_din_station  / combined_plot_dip_station ) +
```

# Limiting nutrient

Proportions of the state of limiting nutrient at each station.

## From 1994-2023

```{r, limiting_nutrient, fig.width=5, fig.height=5}
#| label: fig-limiting_nutrient
#| fig-cap: Figure of Limiting Nutrient

# Plot Limiting_nutrient by Location
limiting_nutrient <- depth_averages_combined %>%
  filter(!is.na(Limiting_nutrient)) %>%
  mutate(Limiting_nutrient = case_when(
  DIN.DIP > 20 ~ "P-limited (DIN:DIP > 20)",
  DIN.DIP >= 12 & DIN.DIP <= 20 ~ "Balanced/Greyzone (12 ≤ DIN:DIP ≤ 20)",
  DIN.DIP < 12  ~ "N-limited (DIN:DIP < 12)"
 # DIN.DIP < 12 & DIN.DIP > 6 ~ "N-limited (6 < DIN:DIP < 12)",
#  DIN.DIP <= 6 ~ "Strongly N-limited (DIN:DIP ≤ 6)"
)) %>%
    mutate(Limiting_nutrient = factor(
    Limiting_nutrient, 
    levels = c("P-limited (DIN:DIP > 20)", 
               "Balanced/Greyzone (12 ≤ DIN:DIP ≤ 20)", 
               "N-limited (DIN:DIP < 12)")
              # "N-limited (6 < DIN:DIP < 12)", 
              # "Strongly N-limited (DIN:DIP ≤ 6)")
  )) %>%
  # Generate a larger interval to visualize before and after a shift in Limiting_nutrient
  mutate(Winter_Season = as.numeric(Winter_Season)) %>%  
  mutate(Interval_big = case_when(
      between(Winter_Season, 1994, 2002) ~ "1994-2002",
      between(Winter_Season, 2003, 2023) ~ "2003-2023" )) %>%
  mutate(Basin_Location = paste(Basin, Location, sep = ", ")) %>%
  mutate(Basin_Location = factor(Basin_Location, levels = c("Bothnian Bay, Swedish Coast", 
                                                            "Bothnian Sea, Swedish Coast", 
                                                            "Bothnian Bay, Finnish Coast", 
                                                            "Bothnian Sea, Finnish Coast", 
                                                            "Bothnian Bay, Offshore", 
                                                            "Bothnian Sea, Offshore"))) %>%
      mutate(Station = factor(Station, levels = c(
                                              "RA2", 
                                               "P1", 
                                               "P LAV4", 
                                               "A5",
                                               "A13",
                                               "Raahen ed RE15",
                                               "B3", 
                                               "B7", 
                                               "Vav-11 V-4", 
                                               "Vav-10 V-3",
                                               "GA1", 
                                               "C3",
                                               "C1",
                                               "Tallvarpen", 
                                               "C14",
                                               "Gårdsfjärden", 
                                               "Söderhamnsfjärden", 
                                               "Ljusnefjärden", 
                                               "C24/SR3",
                                               "Raum 385", 
                                               "Raum 395",
                                               "Östhammar"
                                               ))) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = Station, fill = Limiting_nutrient)) +
    #facet_wrap(~ Interval_big, scales = "free", nrow = 2) +  # Facettera efter plats och bassäng
   scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "P-limited (DIN:DIP > 20)" =  "#6CAED6",
    "Balanced/Greyzone (12 ≤ DIN:DIP ≤ 20)" = "#8CCB89",
    "N-limited (DIN:DIP < 12)" = "#FFAC4D"
   # "N-limited (6 < DIN:DIP < 12)" = "#FFAC4D",
   # "Strongly N-limited (DIN:DIP ≤ 6)" = "#E68E8E"
  )) + 
  facet_wrap(~ Basin ,  ncol = 2, scales = "free_x") + 
  guides(fill = guide_legend(ncol = 1, byrow = TRUE)) +
  geom_bar(position = "fill") +
  labs(x = "Station", y = "Proportion", fill = "Limiting Nutrient",
      title = "Limiting nutrient for each station, from north to south",) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1, vjust = 0.5),
        legend.position = "bottom",
        plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5)
        ) 

```

# Map - Gulf of Bothnia

```{r, map, fig.width=7, fig.height=7}
#| label: fig-map
#| fig-cap: Map of the Gulf of Bothnia

library(ggplot2)
library(rnaturalearth)
library(rnaturalearthdata)
library(ggspatial)
library(ggrepel)
library(sf)

# Ladda in stationsdata, Lat och Long
sites_st <- read_excel(paste(path,"Koordinater_c1.xlsx",sep="")) %>%
  mutate(Namn = case_when(
          Namn %in% c("C24") ~ "C24/SR3",
          Namn %in% c("Raum 385 J") ~ "Raum 385",
          Namn %in% c("Raum 395 R") ~ "Raum 395",
          TRUE ~ Namn))

#Transect
sites_tr <- read_excel(paste(path,"Koordinater_transekt.xlsx",sep="")) %>%
  #Select stations
  filter( Namn == "A19" |
          Namn == "A19-S" |
          Namn == "B5" |
          Namn == "B5-N" |
          Namn == "B1-S2" |
          Namn == "B1-S1" |
          Namn == "B1" |
          Namn == "B1-N")

#Join stations and transect coordinates
sites <- full_join(sites_st, sites_tr, by = c("Namn", "Lat", "Long"))

# Kontrollera och konvertera till sf-objekt
sites_sf <- st_as_sf(sites_st, coords = c("Long", "Lat"), crs = 4326)  # WGS84 (EPSG:4326)
sites_sf_tr <- st_as_sf(sites_tr, coords = c("Long", "Lat"), crs = 4326)  # WGS84 (EPSG:4326)

# Stäng av S2
sf_use_s2(FALSE)

# Ladda världskartan och filtrera Sverige och Finland
world <- ne_countries(scale = "medium", returnclass = "sf")
sweden_finland <- world %>%
  filter(admin %in% c("Sweden", "Finland"))

# Lägg till färg på stationerna baserat på faktorordningen
sites_sf <- sites_sf %>%
  mutate(
    Namn = factor(
      Namn,
      levels = c(
        "RA2", 
        "P 1", 
        "P LAV4", 
        "A5",
        "A13",
        "Raahen ed RE15",
        "B3", 
        "B7", 
        "Vav-11 V-4", 
        "Vav-10 V-3",
        "GA1", 
        "C3",
        "C1",
        "Tallvarpen", 
        "C14",
        "Gårdsfjärden", 
        "Söderhamnsfjärden", 
        "Ljusnefjärden", 
        "C24/SR3",
        "Raum 385", 
        "Raum 395", 
        "Östhammar"
      )
    ),

    # Add Basin
    Basin = case_when(
      Namn %in% c(
        "RA2", 
        "P 1", 
        "P LAV4", 
        "A5",
        "A13",
        "Raahen ed RE15"
      ) ~ "Bothnian Bay",

      Namn %in% c(
        "B3", 
        "B7", 
        "Vav-11 V-4", 
        "Vav-10 V-3",
        "GA1", 
        "C3",
        "C1",
        "Tallvarpen", 
        "C14",
        "Gårdsfjärden", 
        "Söderhamnsfjärden", 
        "Ljusnefjärden", 
        "C24/SR3",
        "Raum 385", 
        "Raum 395", 
        "Östhammar"
      ) ~ "Bothnian Sea",

      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),

    # Add Location
    Location = case_when(
      Namn %in% c(
        "A5", "A13", "C1", "C3", "C14", "C24/SR3"
      ) ~ "Offshore",

      Namn %in% c(
        "RA2", 
        "B3", 
        "B7", 
        "GA1",
        "Gårdsfjärden", 
        "Söderhamnsfjärden", 
        "Ljusnefjärden", 
        "Östhammar"
      ) ~ "Swedish coast",

      Namn %in% c(
        "P 1", 
        "P LAV4", 
        "Raahen ed RE15",
        "Vav-11 V-4", 
        "Vav-10 V-3",
        "Tallvarpen", 
        "Raum 385", 
        "Raum 395"
      ) ~ "Finnish coast",

      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),

    # Combine Basin + Location
    Basin_Location = paste(Basin, Location, sep = ", "),

    # Set desired order
    Basin_Location = factor(
      Basin_Location,
      levels = c(
        "Bothnian Bay, Swedish coast", 
        "Bothnian Sea, Swedish coast", 
        "Bothnian Bay, Finnish coast", 
        "Bothnian Sea, Finnish coast", 
        "Bothnian Bay, Offshore", 
        "Bothnian Sea, Offshore"
      )
    ),

    # Combine all three
    Basin_Location_Station = paste(
      Basin, Location, Namn, sep = " "
    )
  )


#Find color hex codes for colors
#library(scales)
#show_col(hue_pal(direction=-1)(22))
colors <- c( 
  "RA2" = "#F8766D", #RA2
 "P 1" = "#EC8239", #P1
 "P LAV4" = "#DB8E00", #P LAV
 "Raahen ed RE15" =   "#C79800", #Raah
 "A5" = "#AEA200", #A5
"A13" =  "#8FAA00", #A13
"B3" =  "#64B200", #B3
"B7" =  "#00B81B", #B7
"GA1" =  "#00BD5C", #GA1
"Gårdsfjärden" =  "#00C085", #Gårdsfj
"Söderhamnsfjärden" =  "#00C1A7", #Söderhamnsfj
"Ljusnefjärden" =  "#00BFC4", #Ljusnefj
"Östhammar" =  "#00BADE", # Östhammar
"Vav-11 V-4" =  "#00B2F3", #Vav-11 V-4
"Vav-10 V-3" =  "#00A6FF", #Vav-10 V-3
"Tallvarpen" =  "#7B96FF", #Tallvarpen
"Raum 385" =  "#B385FF", #Raum 385
"Raum 395" =  "#D874FD", #Raum 395
"C3" =  "#EF67EB", #C3
"C1" =  "#FD61D3", #C1
"C14" =  "#FF63B6", #C14
"C24/SR3" =  "#FF6B94" #C24
  )


# Kartplotten
map <- ggplot() +
  # Sverige och Finland
  geom_sf(data = sweden_finland, fill = "#F7F2EE", colour = "darkgrey") +
  # Annoteringar för regionnamn
  annotate("text", x = 23.3, y = 64.8, label = "Bothnian \nBay", 
           size = 4, color = "darkgrey", fontface = "italic") +
  annotate("text", x = 19.5, y = 61.5, label = "Bothnian \nSea", 
           size = 4, color = "darkgrey", fontface = "italic") +
    annotate("text", x = 21.75, y = 63.4, label = "Northern \nQuark", 
           size = 2.1, color = "darkgrey", fontface = "italic") +
        annotate("text", x = 20.3, y = 60.3, label = "Southern \nQuark", 
           size = 2.1, color = "darkgrey", fontface = "italic") +
 # annotate("text", x = 21, y = 63.5, label = "Gulf  of Bothnia", 
 #         size = 8, color = "grey", fontface = "italic", angle = 55, hjust = 0.5) +
  annotate("text", x = 18, y = 65, label = "Sweden", 
           size = 7.5, color = "white") +
  annotate("text", x = 23.5, y = 62, label = "Finland", 
           size = 7.5, color = "white") +
  # Stationspunkter färgade efter Station (använder ggplot's standardfärger)
  geom_sf(data = sites_sf, aes(fill = Namn), shape = 21, color = "black", size = 3) + 
  scale_fill_manual(values = colors) +
  # Transectpunkter
  geom_sf(data = sites_sf_tr, aes(fill = Namn), shape = 21, color = "black", size = 2, fill = "steelblue") +
  # Stationspunkter Etiketter med rätt koordinater
  geom_text_repel(data = sites_sf, aes(geometry = geometry, label = Namn), 
                  stat = "sf_coordinates", size = 3, color = "black") +
  # Transect labels
  geom_text_repel(
    data = sites_sf_tr,
    aes(geometry = geometry, label = Namn),
    stat = "sf_coordinates",
    size = 1.7,
    box.padding = 0.15,
    point.padding = 0.05,
    force = 0.2,
    max.overlaps = Inf,
    seed = 123,
    segment.color = NA
    ) + 
  # Lägg till en skala i hörnet
  annotation_scale(location = "br", text_cex = 0.6) +
  # Anpassa koordinatsystemet för Bottniska viken
  coord_sf(xlim = c(16, 25), ylim = c(59.5, 66.5), expand = FALSE) +
  # Layout och teman
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "", x = "", y = "",  fill = "Stations") + #Map of the Gulf of Bothnia
  guides(fill = guide_legend(ncol = 1)) +
  theme(
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "#DBE1E3"),
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    panel.border = element_rect(color = "darkgrey", fill = NA),  # Grå linje runt havskanten
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5)
  )  ; map

```

# Map transect

```{r, map_transect, fig.width=8, fig.height=7}
#| label: fig-map_transect
#| fig-cap: Transect in the Northern Quark

library(ggplot2)
library(rnaturalearth)
library(rnaturalearthdata)
library(ggspatial)
library(ggrepel)
library(sf)

# Ladda in stationsdata, Lat och Long
sites <- read_excel(paste(path,"Koordinater_transekt.xlsx",sep="")) 

# Kontrollera och konvertera till sf-objekt
sites_sf <- st_as_sf(sites, coords = c("Long", "Lat"), crs = 4326)  # WGS84 (EPSG:4326)

# Stäng av S2
sf_use_s2(FALSE)

# Ladda världskartan och filtrera Sverige och Finland
world <- ne_countries(scale = "medium", returnclass = "sf")
sweden_finland <- world %>%
  filter(admin %in% c("Sweden", "Finland"))


# Kartplotten
map_transect <- ggplot() +
  # Sverige och Finland
  geom_sf(data = sweden_finland, fill = "#F7F2EE", colour = "darkgrey") +
  # Stationspunkter färgade efter Station (använder ggplot's standardfärger)
  geom_sf(data = sites_sf, fill = "steelblue", shape = 21, color = "black", size = 5) +
  # Etiketter med rätt koordinater
  geom_text_repel(data = sites_sf, aes(geometry = geometry, label = Namn), 
                  stat = "sf_coordinates", size = 5, color = "black",
                  nudge_x = -0.1,      # Nudges labels to the right
                    nudge_y = 0.1) +
  # Annoteringar för regionnamn
  annotate("text", x = 22.3, y = 64.25, label = "Bothnian \nBay", 
           size = 6, color = "darkgrey", fontface = "italic") +
  annotate("text", x = 20, y = 62.8, label = "Bothnian \nSea", 
           size = 6, color = "darkgrey", fontface = "italic") +
  annotate("text", x = 21.75, y = 63.5, label = "The Northern \nQuark", 
           size = 5, color = "darkgrey", fontface = "italic") +
  # Lägg till en skala i hörnet
  annotation_scale(location = "br", text_cex = 0.6) +
  # Anpassa koordinatsystemet för Bottniska viken
  coord_sf(xlim = c(17, 23), ylim = c(62.5, 65), expand = FALSE) +
  # Layout och teman
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Transect in the Northern Quark", x = "", y = "",  fill = "Station") +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(ncol = 1)) +
  theme(
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "#DBE1E3"),
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    panel.border = element_rect(color = "darkgrey", fill = NA),  # Grå linje runt havskanten
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5)
  ); map_transect
```

# Save all ggplot-objects automatically

This automatic saving does not remember the size settings in each R-chunk.

```{r, save_function}

#Sätt output-path
output_path <- "/Figures/"

# Lista alla objekt och välj endast ggplot-objekten
ggplot_objects <- ls(envir = .GlobalEnv)  # Lista alla objekt
ggplot_objects <- ggplot_objects[sapply(ggplot_objects, function(x) inherits(get(x), "gg"))]  # Filtrera de som är ggplot-objekt

# Funktion för att spara varje plot
save_plots <- function(plot_objects, path) {
  for (plot_name in plot_objects) {
    plot <- get(plot_name)  # Hämta plot-objektet
    file_name <- paste0(path, plot_name, ".pdf")  # Skapa filnamnet
    ggsave(file_name, plot)  # Spara plotten
  }
}

# Spara alla plots
save_plots(ggplot_objects, output_path)

```
